items.title: Terry Clark — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He was a good trumpet teacher... Buch had a ruler with a piece of tape around it. He’d slap him... and then say, “Stop shaking that note.”

ctx.x: Tell me something about Elwood Buchanan.

You know what? The only thing I ever knew about Buch was that he and I were pretty good beer drinkers. He was a good trumpet teacher and a good – he had a heck of a reputation over in East St. Louis as a good educator.
What kind of beer did you drink?
